payload.title: Reconcile commission lifecycle and collected cash
payload.goal: Keep pending, approved, reversed, paid and cash-received affiliate amounts separately verifiable.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Qualify approved merchant/network read-only export/API for transactions and payouts; store private evidence by reference and sanitized aggregate projection only.
Use merchant+transaction+event revision identities; append pending/approved/reversed/paid transitions, partial reversals, currency/FX basis, fees and payout reconciliation without double counting.
Record cash actually received separately from paid status; retain dates for earned-window versus cash-window attribution and report missing provider data as unknown.
Enforce no spend before collected cash and rolling 24-hour cap of 50% cash available at period start; pending approvals and payout estimates do not expand allowance.
Investigate mismatch once with next-check cursor; source commission disputes to network/merchant, not customer order mutation.
deliverables: sanitized financial statement and private receipt references
tests: Duplicate/out-of-order exports, partial reversal after payout, multiple currencies and missing payout proof preserve reconciled balances.
Five ledger states remain separately reportable; paid with absent bank/provider cash receipt cannot count as collected cash.
Quota/spend check rejects attempts based on pending balance or repeated half-balance splitting.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: A real available report reconciles aggregate amounts to provider evidence and cash receipt references; no reports means unvalidated financial outcome.
Affiliate click/estimated sale never becomes commission or cash automatically.
payload.rollback: Stop imports or financial proposals, preserve raw private receipts and append corrections; do not overwrite prior statements.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement duplicate/reversal/payout fixtures against the five-state ledger.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Actual program access and transaction reports depend on affiliate eligibility; fixtures remain executable.
